June 2026 — Northern Colorado Monthly Market Report

The full Northern Colorado monthly market report — with the live IRES MLS data, county breakdowns, town-by-town stats, the top sale of the month, and Christine's take — lives on the Bold Collective Homes site. Here's the quick version:

Weighted median sale price $575,000 — weighted by each town’s sale count for accuracy. Average days on market 56 days regionally. Average sale-to-list ratio 98.3% — sellers are still close to ask, buyers winning on well-priced homes. Source IRES MLS — the same multiple-listing service I use to price every listing. No Zestimates. No national-aggregator guesses. Just receipts.

Want the full report? Read the complete Northern Colorado market analysis (Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, Windsor, Erie, Longmont) with all the data, charts, and Christine's commentary on the canonical version:

Read the full report on Bold Collective Homes
